card.name: Partway through split words and URLs
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of a longer string that continues in the next piece. This includes URL parts, hyphenated compounds, and capitalised warning-header words split like PERIPHER-AL.

modes.label: Split capitalised warning words
modes.description: The AL piece inside an all-caps boxed warning heading word that continues after it.

modes.label: URL and tag pieces
modes.description: A middle piece of a web address or a hyphenated config tag name.

modes.label: Hyphenated compounds
modes.description: A piece after a hyphen in a compound such as single-dose or front-tier.
